description: Use this when the user asks what a note or raw material smells like or is (for example vetiver, oud, vanilla, iris, ambroxan, bergamot), whether it is natural or synthetic, or what it pairs with (synonyms: what does X smell like, ingredient, note). Returns how it smells, its family, natural or synthetic, pairings and perfumes that show it, with the scento.com page in the user's language. Don't use to find perfumes containing notes (use material-match) or to define a perfumery term such as sillage (perfumery-lexicon).

lang.description: Language of the scento.com links and labels; answers stay in English. Use the language the user writes in, for example "de" (German), "fr" (French), "es" (Spanish) or "it" (Italian). Default "en".

material.description: One note or raw material, by common name. Examples: "vetiver", "orris", "ambroxan", "pink pepper", "oud".
